accepted_objects.valuation_object: real earnings yield, candidate construction = inverse CAPE
accepted_objects.series_identifier: ie_data.xls, sheet 'Data', CAPE column (col index 16); supporting columns: Comp. price, Earnings, CPI
accepted_objects.pit_reasoning: Coverage and currency are fine, but the history is RECONSTRUCTED, not vintage. Shiller's file is rebuilt each month: trailing earnings are revised after the fact, and the real series is deflated with the CURRENT CPI vintage rather than the CPI that was published at the time. No true vintages are distributed. A declared publication lag makes the construction causal with respect to RELEASE TIMING, but it does NOT remove revision bias - a value dated 1995-03 is today's estimate of 1995-03, not what an investor could have computed in 1995-03. That limitation must be carried into the preregistration and must not be described as point-in-time.
accepted_objects.assumed_publication_lag: TO BE DECLARED IN S1. S&P quarterly earnings are finalised with a multi-month lag and CPI is released with roughly a one-month lag, so a conservative lag of at least 2-3 months is indicated; the exact value is an Owner decision, not a fitted parameter.
accepted_objects.known_revision_limitations: Earnings revised; CPI revised/rebased; no vintage file published.
accepted_objects.provenance_trap: The legacy Yale URL http://www.econ.yale.edu/~shiller/data/ie_data.xls still resolves but serves a STALE copy ending 2023.09 (sha256 0df9392b7dacf91f756e92c8db508ad903c4588b43f3253680eec3dd8b40db68). Only the shillerdata.com link above is current. Verified this retrieval.

accepted_objects.valuation_object: real yield (Market real yield, 20y TIPS constant maturity)
accepted_objects.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
accepted_objects.pit_reasoning: Market-observed quote. Published next business day and not revised, so a one-business-day lag is sufficient and no vintage problem arises.
accepted_objects.maturity_correspondence_note: closest maturity correspondence to TLT (20+ year Treasuries)
accepted_objects.known_structural_issues: TIPS market liquidity was thin and distorted in the early years and again acutely in 2008-2009; a 20y TIPS real yield before roughly 2005 should be treated cautiously.

blocked_objects.intended_series: BAMLC0A0CM (ICE BofA US Corporate Index OAS, via FRED)
blocked_objects.reason: LICENSING, not coverage. FRED serves this series under ICE Data Indices terms that state 'Reproduction of this data in any form is prohibited except with the prior written permission of ICE Data Indices' and that the values are 'provided for your internal use only'. Consistent with that, the CSV endpoint returns only a rolling recent window - 795 rows, 2023-09-12 to 2026-09-10 - and ignores cosd/coed requests for earlier history. Roughly three years cannot support an EXPANDING_OWN_HISTORY anchor with a warm-up, and the licence blocks redistributing a snapshot for reproducibility. The probe copies were deleted, not retained.

blocked_objects.reason: Identical ICE Data Indices licence and identical rolling window (795 rows, 2023-09-12 to 2026-09-10). Deleted, not retained.

blocked_objects.valuation_object: real exchange rate vs the fixed USDX basket weights
blocked_objects.intended_series: DEXUSEU/DEXJPUS/DEXUSUK/DEXCAUS/DEXSDUS/DEXSZUS + CPIAUCSL + one CPI per basket currency
blocked_objects.reason: The nominal FX legs are all available and clean (1971-2026). The CPI legs are not. The USDX basket needs all six currencies (EUR 57.6%, JPY 13.6%, GBP 11.9%, CAD 9.1%, SEK 4.2%, CHF 3.6%). Japan's OECD CPI on FRED is DISCONTINUED at 2021-06 across every variant tried (JPNCPIALLMINMEI, JPNCPICORMINMEI, CPGRLE01JPM659N, JPNCPALTT01IXNBM, CPALCY01JPM661N ends 2022-04), and the UK, Canada, Sweden and Switzerland MEI series all stop at 2025-03/2025-04. Only the euro area (CP0000EZ19M086NEST) is current. The OECD public SDMX API returned HTTP 403 for both query forms tried. A basket that is 13.6% stale by five years and a further 29% stale by 17 months cannot support an evaluation running to 2026. Per A8 no BIS effective index and no price-based proxy was substituted.

DEXJPUS and US CPI are both fine. The study fails on the Japan CPI leg alone: every FRED variant is discontinued at 2021-06 (one at 2022-04), and the OECD SDMX public API returned HTTP 403. Without a current Japanese price index the real exchange rate cannot be carried to the evaluation end, and the object is not feasible from sources reachable here. Retained the nominal and US-CPI legs; substituted nothing.
